title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill x2 Blueberry Pomegranate 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy’s Seriously Pod Fill x2 Blueberry Pomegranate is a richly layered fusion of plump, juicy Blueberries and the sweet, tangy burst of Pomegranate. The Blueberry delivers a deep, natural sweetness with a hint of tartness, while the Pomegranate adds a refreshing, slightly sharp contrast that keeps the flavour bright and lively. This well-balanced blend creates a smooth yet vibrant vape, perfect for fruit lovers. With a 50% VG / 50% PG formulation, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, making it ideal for low-powered vape kits, pod systems, starter devices, and high-resistance coils. The balanced formula ensures a consistent flavour and a smooth yet tactile throat hit with discreet vapour production. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Doozy is a leading UK e-liquid brand known for its diverse flavour profiles and high-quality formulations. The Seriously Pod Fill x2 range is specially crafted for MTL vapers, offering double-concentrated flavours with a smooth yet tactile throat hit in a versatile 50/50 blend.
